# 🧰 Documentation and QA templates

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Architecture decision record](adr-template.md) | Record a significant architecture decision |
| [Threat assessment](threat-assessment-template.md) | Capture assets, threats and mitigations |
| [Smart contract test](contract-test-template.md) | Specify a Solidity test |
| [Frontend test](frontend-test-template.md) | Specify a React/wallet test |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Record manual and automated checks |
| [Incident report](incident-report-template.md) | Document a security/privacy incident |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Gather release evidence |

Use synthetic details only. Never put patient information, private keys, seed phrases, or confidential transaction metadata in templates or test artifacts.
